'''Cats''' are the central characters in Mewgenics, with everything in the game involving them. 
A cat's appearance is generated from a series of parts using the [[Catgen]] system. The parts are randomly generated on birth or appearance, although body parts can be passed down from the cat's parents.
* An exception to that are the [[Special Strays]], which have predetermined appearances.
* [[Mutations]] and various [[Afflictions]] can also alter a cat's appearance, aside from providing stat modifiers or extra abilities, such as having a 10% chance to reflect projectiles.

The cats in the "[[party]]", known as [[Player Cat]]s, are distinct from other {{Type|Cat}} allies.
